name: WindowsCollector
description: Online Windows diagnostic log collector for running systems. Collects comprehensive system diagnostics, event logs, registry hives, and system health data, then uploads to PhoneHomeWeb server.

parameters.name: Silent
parameters.description: Run without interactive prompts (for EPM deployment)

parameters.name: SkipUpload
parameters.description: Collect logs only, do not upload

parameters.name: OutputPath
parameters.description: Custom output directory for collected logs

collectedData: Event Logs (Application, System, Security, Setup, etc.)
Registry Hives (SYSTEM, SOFTWARE, DEFAULT - excludes SAM/SECURITY)
Disk and storage health (SMART, BitLocker status)
requirements: Run as Administrator/SYSTEM for full collection
author: jeamajoal
